verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੇ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਪਾਹ ਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਣਾ ਵਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hove soot kapaeh dhaa kar taanaa vaanaa|

en.bdb: From cotton the thread and then its warp and waft is prepared.
It is well known that from that very thread the cloth is made.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਸੀ ਤੈ ਚਉਤਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲੁ ਜਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chausee tai chautaar hoi ga(n)gaa jal jaanaa|

en.bdb: Made of the four  threads are what are known as chausi, gangajali etc.(in india).

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਸਾ ਮਲਮਲ ਸਿਰੀਸਾਫੁ ਤਨ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: khaasaa malamal sireesaaf tan sukh man bhaanaa|

en.bdb: The superior clothes (malmal, sirisaph) made out of it impart comfort and pleasure to the body.
By becoming turban, scarf, waist coat etc. that thread from cotton becomes acceptable to one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh ra(n)g maanaa ||10||

en.bdb: The Lord permeates among all and the gurmukhs enjoy His love.
